Top 9 traditional craft villages in Vietnam updated by Vietlook Travel right in the article are brilliant highlights, the unique culture of traditional Vietnamese craft villages is always preserved and promoted, transmitting cultural identity to the next generation.

1. Phu Lang Pottery Village

As one of the famous craft villages that any tourist when having the opportunity to set foot in Bac Ninh will visit, with products meticulously made by artisans of the craft village, exuding the pristine beauty of the land.

2. Ha Thai Lacquer Village

Visiting the Ha Thai Lacquer Village, you will see the peaceful and rustic countryside scenery, exuding the unique beauty of a traditional craft village, with skilled craftsmen creating exquisite works, visitors will be able to personally paint the works with their own creativity and bring them back as gifts.
3. Quat Dong Embroidery Village
As a craft village that has been around for thousands of years, with products that are not only used domestically but also exported abroad, when visiting the village, visitors will encounter mothers and sisters who often embroider at home with exquisite works, if you are someone who wants to learn about traditional craft villages, so Vietnamese culture, this is the destination for you.

4. Dong Ho Painting Village

As a National Intangible Cultural Heritage, when coming here, you will admire unique works, the quality of paintings from clay printing paper and coloring materials have created traditional works bearing the mark of Vietnamese culture.

5. Van Phuc Silk Village

Ha Dong Silk Village or Van Phuc Silk Village The name is no longer strange to tourists from all over the world, the silk village has many old patterns, coming here visitors will encounter very eye-catching display stalls that visitors can buy as gifts, with very sophisticated and beautiful soft products.

6. Kim Son Sedge Village

Sedge mats have long been indispensable in every Vietnamese family, and have become a mark in the national cultural identity, not only bringing income to the people here but also an indispensable tourist destination in the Ninh Binh tour itinerary.

7. Tay Ho Conical Hat Village – Phu Vang

As one of the traditional craft villages that bring beloved conical hats, Tay Ho Conical Hat has long been famous for its elegant beauty, slimness and lightness, further enhancing the beauty of women. If you have the opportunity to travel to Hue, visit Tay Ho Conical Hat Village to feel its own beauty, a rustic scene of the countryside.

8. Tuong Binh Hiep Lacquer Painting Village

This place is not only famous for its lacquer paintings, but also a destination that attracts tourists to visit, with valuable and diverse lacquer works that exude the beauty of the homeland.

9. Trang Bang Rice Paper Craft Village

One of the famous craft villages in Tay Ninh, visitors coming here can not only visit but also enjoy delicious rice paper, a famous specialty that visitors can buy as gifts when they have the opportunity to visit Tay Ninh.

Above are the traditional craft villages in Vietnam updated in this article, which will be an interesting suggestion for tourists who love to explore Vietnamese culture, and learn about traditional craft villages of the nation.
